module_summary: Simple UART with a programmable baud divider register, a counter-driven receive state machine shifting into a one-byte buffer, and a shift-register transmitter with bit counter.

anchors.name: cfg_divider
anchors.why: Byte-writable baud divider compared by both RX and TX counters

anchors.name: recv_state
anchors.why: Receive controller: idle, start-bit half wait, data bits, stop

anchors.name: recv_divcnt
anchors.why: Receive baud counter timing bit sampling against divider

anchors.name: recv_pattern
anchors.why: Receive shift register collecting serial bits LSB first

anchors.name: recv_buf_data
anchors.why: Received byte buffer read through reg_dat_do

anchors.name: recv_buf_valid
anchors.why: Buffer full flag, set on byte receipt, cleared by read

anchors.name: send_pattern
anchors.why: TX shift register with start/stop framing driving ser_tx

anchors.name: send_bitcnt
anchors.why: Remaining TX bits; busy indication for wait and new writes

anchors.name: send_divcnt
anchors.why: TX baud counter timing bit shifts against divider

anchors.name: send_dummy
anchors.why: Pending idle-frame flag after reset or divider write

anchors.name: ser_tx
anchors.why: Serial transmit line from TX shift register LSB

anchors.name: ser_rx
anchors.why: Serial receive line detected for start bit and shifted in

anchors.name: reg_dat_we
anchors.why: Data write command loading TX frame

anchors.name: reg_dat_re
anchors.why: Data read command clearing receive buffer valid

anchors.name: reg_dat_wait
anchors.why: Stalls data writes while transmitter busy

anchors.name: reg_div_we
anchors.why: Per-byte write enables for divider register

groups.name: Baud divider config
groups.description: Programmable divider register read back on reg_div_do

groups.name: Receiver
groups.description: Start-bit detection and timed sampling into shift register

groups.name: Receive buffer
groups.description: One-byte RX buffer with valid flag, read via data register

groups.name: Transmitter
groups.description: Framed TX shift register clocked by divider counter
